<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Navigation between product categories as chips, a bar with an underline, a side list, tiles with a big icon,
  or chips under a toolbar (search, sort and the number shown). The current one carries aria-current. Axes:
  layout (chips, bar, sidebar, tiles, toolbar), count (show, hide), icon (show, hide), density.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Category, CategoryTools } from "./category-nav.types";

  export type CategoryNavProps = {
    label: string;
    categories: Category[];
    current?: string;
    layout?: "chips" | "bar" | "sidebar" | "tiles" | "toolbar";
    count?: "show" | "hide";
    icon?: "show" | "hide";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
    tools?: CategoryTools;
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../compose/Block.svelte";
  import Container from "../compose/Container.svelte";
  import Group from "../compose/Group.svelte";
  import Inline from "../compose/Inline.svelte";
  import List from "../compose/List.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.svelte";
  import Select from "../compose/Select.svelte";
  import SelectOption from "../compose/SelectOption.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import MenuEntry from "../components/menu-entry.svelte";
  import SearchField from "../components/search-field.svelte";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let {
    label,
    categories,
    current = "all",
    layout = "chips",
    count = "show",
    icon = "show",
    density = "default",
    tools,
    landmarkLabel,
  }: CategoryNavProps = $props();
  const chipLike = $derived(((layout as string) === "chips") || ((layout as string) === "toolbar"));
  const tiles = $derived((layout as string) === "tiles");
  const linkShape = $derived(
    chipLike ? "inline-flex h-8 items-center gap-2 rounded px-3 inset-ring inset-ring-border"
    : (layout as string) === "bar" ? "inline-flex items-center gap-2 -mb-px border-b px-1 py-2"
    : tiles ? "flex h-full flex-col items-start gap-4 rounded p-4 inset-ring inset-ring-border"
    : "inline-flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded px-3 py-2"
  );
  const currentLook = $derived(
    chipLike ? "bg-primary text-primary-foreground"
    : (layout as string) === "bar" ? "border-foreground font-semibold"
    : tiles ? "inset-ring-foreground font-semibold"
    : "bg-muted font-semibold"
  );
  const otherLook = $derived(((layout as string) === "bar") ? "border-transparent" : "");
  const listShape = $derived(
    (layout as string) === "sidebar" ? "flex flex-col gap-2"
    : (layout as string) === "bar" ? "flex flex-wrap gap-2 gap-x-4 border-b border-border"
    : tiles ? "grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6"
    : "flex flex-wrap gap-2"
  );
</script>

<Block tag="nav" aria-label={(landmarkLabel ?? label)} data-testid="category-nav" data-layout={layout}>
  <Container
    class={cn("mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4", (((density as string) === "compact") ? "py-2" : "py-4"))}
    data-slot="container"
  >
    {#if ((layout as string) === "toolbar")}
      <Group gap="4" align="center" class="mb-4 flex-wrap" data-testid="toolbar">
        <SearchField value={(tools?.query ?? "")} label={(tools?.search ?? "")} placeholder={tools?.search} />
        <Select name="sort" size="sm" aria-label={tools?.sort} class="w-48">
          <SelectOption value="sort" label={tools?.sortValue} selected={true} />
        </Select>
        <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {tools?.shown}
        </Text>
      </Group>
    {/if}
    {#if ((categories?.length ?? 0) > 0)}
      <List tag="ul" class={listShape} data-testid="items">
        {#each categories as c (c.id)}
          <ListItem>
            <MenuEntry
              href={c.href}
              class={cn("text-sm", linkShape, ((c.id === current) ? currentLook : otherLook))}
              current={(c.id === current)}
              testid="item"
              block={true}
            >
              {#if ((icon as string) === "show")}
                {#if tiles}
                  <Inline class="flex size-10 items-center justify-center rounded bg-muted">
                    <LucideIcon name={c.icon} size={20} />
                  </Inline>
                {:else}
                  <LucideIcon name={c.icon} size={16} />
                {/if}
              {/if}
              <Inline>
                {c.name}
              </Inline>
              {#if ((count as string) === "show")}
                <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
                  {(c.count == null ? undefined : String(c.count))}
                </Text>
              {/if}
            </MenuEntry>
          </ListItem>
        {/each}
      </List>
    {/if}
  </Container>
</Block>
